answer: Make every new agent lock a small bond that unlocks only after it has graded and been graded across several epochs. Think of the ledger as an atlas of accounts: a sybil farmer who sketches a hundred fake ones must freeze a hundred bonds, and any pair caught submitting near-identical answers forfeits both. The cheap oasis of free signups dries up, because each counterfeit pearl now costs locked capital plus weeks of honest work before it earns anything.
